- **BP** — released 03:00 ET. Underlying replacement cost profit $8.46B vs a $7.33B company-compiled
- consensus and $2.2B a year ago; profit attributable to shareholders $4.70B vs $1.16B a year ago. Refining indicator margin $46.7/bbl (from $29.6 in Q2, $15.8 a year ago).

- **AZN** — released 03:00 ET. Q3 revenue $16.21B, +7%; core EPS $2.79, +17% at CER (+19% at
constant currency). FY2026 guidance reaffirmed. Webcast 14:30 GMT / 10:30 ET.

- **NWG** — released 03:00 ET. Attributable profit £1,532m, **−4.4% YoY**, against a consensus that
- had income and NIM broadly on plan (income £4.64B vs £4.6B expected; NIM 2.50% vs 2.51% expected). Operating profit £2,225m, RoTE 21.6%, EPS 19.3p, CET1 13.5%.

- Shares fell in early London trading; the ADR was −7.5% on the Nasdaq premarket print at 06:09 ET.

- **SNY** — released 00:30 ET (press release stamped 06:30 CET). Q3 sales €14,444m, +14.3% at CER;
business EPS €3.55, +19.6% at CER; IFRS EPS €2.52. FY2026 guidance **upgraded**. Webcast 13:30 CET / 08:30 ET.
